source_extracts.label: Brother iPrint&Scan — supported paper sizes
source_extracts.quote: Brother iPrint&Scan lists 4" x 6" (10 x 15 cm) as a supported paper size for printing documents and photos.

source_extracts.label: US Letter paper standard
source_extracts.quote: The standard US letter sheet is 8.5 x 11 inches; 4 x 6 inches is the standard shipping-label size that fits a box face.

source_extracts.label: Mailbox Plus counter QR programs (owner ruling)
source_extracts.quote: QR scanning IS offered for FedEx Easy Returns, Happy Returns, USPS Label Broker. Amazon returns: pre-printed carrier label ONLY, no Amazon QR codes.
